materialScopeObservations: All 12 actual withdrawals occurred at saved country minima. Withdrawal itself awards no qualification; any later qualification must be supported by actual subsequent study.
Italy has 2 acquittals and 2 remand rows but no sentence, prison pay or release. Its 16 unreached milestones remain genuine natural outcomes.
The paid GB Paris trip was interrupted during actual legal consequences; holidayCompleted remains unreached.
AU, BR and IT died before their retirement milestone; US and JP have no observed delayedArrest.
Six countries reached all 26 recorded milestone names. Complete Scenario B remains false: seizure, contraband, native, multigeneration and all-choice coverage were not established.
Foreign work applications only: 22 applications, with no move or foreign contract acceptance. This does not establish foreign residence or earnings.
Actual unforced engine deaths include recorded Hypertension (IT) and declining health (ZA), as well as deaths labelled natural causes.
limits: Only birth uses the actual in-memory SQLite/store. Later immutable engine commands and production checkpoint comparisons do not establish full-life SQLite or native coverage.
This review reads actual JSON, source and hashes only. No game runtime, world decode, policy, codec, SQL, test, device, replay or outcome search was executed.
The 413 producer-reported round-trip assertions include overlapping milestone, bound and final states. They are not 413 new reviewer replays or distinct lives.
All raw unreached objects, observations, negative availability details, cold checks and financial records remain in the exact pinned country files. This summary does not replace or repair them.
Elapsed time describes the cohort duration, not physical UI latency.
Reused seeds 900..911 add no distinct annual seeds to the separate 120-seed coverage. This policy does not run Scenarios A or C.
